module_summary: AXI-lite write-channel clock-domain crossing: slave-side registers capture aw/w, two 2-state FSMs exchange a toggle flag via 2-flop synchronizers, master-side registers issue the write and return bresp.

anchors.name: s_state_reg
anchors.why: Slave-domain FSM: waits for aw+w, raises flag, awaits master done, returns response.

anchors.name: m_state_reg
anchors.why: Master-domain FSM: issues write on synced flag, waits bvalid, signals completion.

anchors.name: s_flag_reg
anchors.why: Request flag from slave domain announcing captured write transaction.

anchors.name: s_flag_sync_reg_2
anchors.why: Synchronized request flag in master domain starting master FSM.

anchors.name: m_flag_reg
anchors.why: Completion flag from master domain after write response received.

anchors.name: m_flag_sync_reg_2
anchors.why: Synchronized completion flag in slave domain advancing slave FSM.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid_reg
anchors.why: Captured aw valid; holds address slot full and gates awready.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Captured w valid; holds data slot full and gates wready.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr_reg
anchors.why: Holds write address across the clock crossing.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata_reg
anchors.why: Holds write data across the clock crossing.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side write response valid; blocks new aw/w acceptance.

anchors.name: s_axil_bresp_reg
anchors.why: Write response code copied from master domain.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid_reg
anchors.why: Master-side aw valid, set on new transfer, cleared by awready.

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Master-side w valid, set on new transfer, cleared by wready.

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata_reg
anchors.why: Master-side write data register driving m_axil_wdata.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid_reg
anchors.why: Captured master bvalid; completes master FSM and drives bready.

anchors.name: m_axil_bresp_reg
anchors.why: Captured response code returned to slave domain.

groups.name: Slave-side capture
groups.description: Captures aw/w channels, holds them, returns write response to slave.

groups.name: Slave controller
groups.description: Slave-domain FSM raising request flag and waiting for completion.

groups.name: CDC synchronizers
groups.description: 2-flop synchronizers carrying request and completion flags across domains.

groups.name: Master controller
groups.description: Master-domain FSM issuing write and raising completion flag.

groups.name: Master-side issue
groups.description: Drives aw/w on master bus and captures b response.
